_comment: n8n Workflow Blueprint — Notion Affiliate Agent (AI Brokerage Arm). DRAFT / BLUEPRINT — AWAITING FOUNDER ACTIVATION. No workflow has been imported into live n8n. Reuses existing n8n instance at http://localhost:5678 and existing Telegram notification pattern (04_Telegram_Notify).
name: Notion Affiliate — Draft Generator & Review Pipeline

nodes.description: Trigger: New entry created in Notion Content Calendar (Product Tracker relation, Content Type, Platform, Publish Date). For local fallback without Notion API, trigger is Manual Trigger that reads notion_affiliate_agent/local_store.json content_calendar additions.

config.mode: ManualTrigger for local development; Notion Trigger (databaseId: Content Calendar) for production after NOTION_API_KEY is set
config.polling: On new database item (Notion) or manual (local)

nodes.description: Call GROQ via existing ai_capability/orchestrator.py HTTP endpoint or direct GROQ API. Uses content_pipeline.py prompt for content_type (Review/Comparison/Guide/Template). Passes product_name, audience, competitor.

config.url: http://localhost:3000/api/agent/builder (existing GROQ pipeline — reuses groq-sdk, no duplication)
config.reuse: ai_capability/orchestrator.py — existing GROQ SDK, no new infrastructure

nodes.description: Save generated draft to notion_affiliate_agent/drafts/<slug>.md AND update local_store.json content_calendar entry Status to 'Draft Ready' + 'Needs Founder Personal Input' flag. For Notion mode, update Notion page Status to 'Draft Ready'.

Notify Founder for human review via existing Telegram pattern (reuses 04_Telegram_Notify logic). Sends: 'Draft ready: <Title> (<Content Type> for <Audience>) — needs Founder personal input at [specific spot] — review at drafts/<slug>.md'

body.text: 📝 Notion Affiliate Draft Ready: {{ $json.title }} — Status: DRAFT — AWAITING FOUNDER REVIEW — {{ $json.flags }} — Review at: drafts/{{ $json.slug }}.md

founder_approval_branch._comment: This branch ONLY executes after Founder manually changes Status to 'Founder Approved' in Notion or local_store.json. It is NOT autonomous.
founder_approval_branch.trigger: Notion Trigger: Status changes to 'Founder Approved' OR Manual Trigger: Founder runs notion_affiliate_agent/on_founder_approval.py

nodes.description: On Founder approval only: log to tracking — update content_calendar Status to 'Founder Approved', record approval timestamp. Do NOT auto-publish.

Schedule performance check after 7 days: Wait 7 days, then HTTP Request to log Performance Tracker entry with Status='Pending Check' and Check Date = publish_date + 7 days. Founder manually fills clicks/conversions from Cuelinks dashboard后.

steps: 2. If approved, import via n8n UI: Workflows → Import from File → select this file, OR via CLI: n8n import:workflow --input=notion_affiliate_agent/n8n_blueprint.json (requires n8n offline, same as ADR-045)
3. Configure Notion Trigger with NOTION_API_KEY and databaseId (after databases are created)
4. For local mode, keep Manual Trigger and test with: node notion_affiliate_agent/content_pipeline.py
5. Toggle Active in n8n UI (manual, same as BLOCKERS.md #1)

reuse_notes.groq: Existing ai_capability/orchestrator.py + groq-sdk — no new API, no duplication
reuse_notes.telegram: Existing lib/telegram_direct.js + 04_Telegram_Notify pattern — no new notification infra

conversion_strategy_mapping._comment: How this n8n blueprint maps to the 4-step conversion strategy (separate directive) — all steps are BLUEPRINT only
conversion_strategy_mapping.step1_web_store: Notion affiliate content drives to store/landing page — this blueprint's drafts (reviews/comparisons) include product-specific affiliate links that would route to Step 1 store in future
conversion_strategy_mapping.step2_audience_education: Content templates (Guide, Template) educate audience — drafts include How to Order copy pattern
conversion_strategy_mapping.step3_automated_dm: Blueprint is intentionally NOT connected to live Instagram/Facebook/WhatsApp — would require ManyChat/Make.com connection, flagged as HUMAN-ONLY per standing directive
conversion_strategy_mapping.step4_pixel_tracking: Performance Tracker + 7-day check is the data-schema precursor to pixel tracking — actual pixel activation is HUMAN-ONLY
